## Files matching `.github/**`

# GitHub workflows

These workflows and actions run on GitHub Actions in `unfold-hq/unfold`, from the cutover in [ADR-0055](https://forgejo.webgrip.dev/webgrip/unfold/src/branch/development/docs/adr/adr-0055-github-unfold-hq-is-the-project-home.md); until then `.forgejo/` runs CI and releases, so a change to one needs the same change in the other. [Their section of the CI guide](https://forgejo.webgrip.dev/webgrip/unfold/src/branch/development/docs/operations/ci.md#github-actions-after-the-cutover-proposed) explains each workflow.

- Start every job's `if:` with `github.repository == 'unfold-hq/unfold'`, pin actions to a full commit and images to a digest, and never name a Webgrip host, secret or shared action. Run `mise run release-check-github` after a change.
- Only `on_release_published.yml`, run at a release tag, may sign: the cluster admits that file's keyless identity and nothing else.
